title: SSR: Can Simulated Patients Learn to Stigmatize Themselves? Modeling Self-Stigma through Internal Monologue

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the simulation of internalized self-stigma (internalization of societal prejudices) in patient agents through fine-tuning on internal monologues and measuring expressions of stigma—such as avoidance, denial, and self-blame—using psychometric scales (SSMIS, ISMI), linguistic inquiry (LIWC), and expert human evaluation of authenticity.
